bio: The more casual sister to Michelin-Starred 42 is a smart, informal bistro set amongst upmarket artisan businesses in the recently opened Esztergom Market. Find a seat in the cosy bistro-cum-bar or on the sun-drenched terrace and choose from a concise menu of fresh, flavour-packed dishes crafted from local produce. Tradition leads the way, with the likes of pork rillettes and pancakes with cottage cheese. Come for breakfast, a leisurely lunch or a lively evening out....
